## 1. Executive Summary & Philosophy
Himanshu Bharti is a Senior Software and AI Systems Engineer specializing in real-time multimodal voice pipelines, deterministic autonomous agent state-graphs, and distributed high-throughput backends. The portfolio blends low-level systems programming (sub-millisecond event buses, audio buffering, memory economics) with high-end editorial broadsheet aesthetics and interactive Three.js WebGL spatial computing.

All production workloads emphasize deterministic execution over stochastic trial-and-error: strict state machines, idempotency locks, sub-500ms voice turnaround, and hybrid dense-sparse vector grounding with verified provenance.

---

## 2. Technical Stack & Core Competencies

### AI & Autonomous Agent Orchestration
- **Frameworks & State Machines**: LangGraph (directed acyclic state graphs), LangChain, DSPy, LlamaIndex.
- **Inference & Serving**: vLLM (PagedAttention, chunked prefill), Ollama, TensorRT-LLM, speculative decoding.
- **Vector & Semantic Retrieval**: pgvector (HNSW indexing), MongoDB Vector Search, BM25 lexical inverted indexes, Cohere Rerank v3 cross-encoders, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
- **Tool Calling & Reliability**: Deterministic function routers, structured output schemas (Pydantic / Zod), prompt caching, Redis snapshot checkpointing, idempotency locks.

### Backend & Distributed Infrastructure
- **Languages**: Python (3.11+), Go (Golang), TypeScript, Node.js (Express / Fastify).
- **APIs & Protocols**: FastAPI, WebSockets (full-duplex streaming), WebRTC (audio Datachannels), gRPC, REST.
- **Data & Message Queues**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis Streams, BullMQ, Apache Kafka.
- **Cloud & Orchestration**: Docker multi-stage builds, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS (ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch), Cloudflare Workers, Terraform.

### Frontend, Graphics & Design Engineering
- **Core Framework**: React 19, Vite, Next.js.
- **Graphics & Spatial Web**: Three.js (PBR materials, custom GLSL shaders, raycasting, dynamic lighting).
- **Styling & Design System**: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS Custom Properties, semantic token inversion (Dark Mode: Deep Obsidian `#131411` & Warm Cream `#f2f0e6`), responsive editorial typography (`EB Garamond` serif & `Hanken Grotesk` sans).

## 4. Production Systems & Case Studies

### Project 01: OmniChannel AI CRM & Autonomous Sales Pipeline
- **URL**: `https://hkbharti77.website/#work`
- **Architecture**: FastAPI event loop with async Redis event bus, PostgreSQL with pgvector, WhatsApp Cloud API webhooks with retry idempotency, LangChain agentic state-graphs.
- **Empirical Results**:
  - `-72%` customer response latency.
  - `10,000+` daily automated conversational steps.
  - `+28.4%` lead conversion lift over manual triage.

### Project 02: VoiceStream — Spectral Latency Engine
- **URL**: `https://hkbharti77.website/#engineering-ai`
- **Architecture**: Full-duplex WebRTC 48kHz PCM audio stream. 30ms Silero VAD sliding window, Deepgram Nova-2 interim tokens (140ms), Claude 3.5 speculative first-token SSE dispatch, ElevenLabs Turbo WebSocket synthesis into Web Audio API circular ring buffer with drift correction.
- **Empirical Results**:
  - `430ms` total end-to-end turn turnaround (sub-500ms benchmark).
  - `1.2ms` WebRTC buffer jitter.

### Project 03: Enterprise RAG Intelligence & Document Cognitive Engine
- **URL**: `https://hkbharti77.website/#work`
- **Architecture**: Hybrid dense-sparse vector scoring combining pgvector/MongoDB Vector Search with BM25 full-text GIN indexing. Merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and scored through Cohere Rerank v3 cross-encoder with citation claim verification.
- **Empirical Results**:
  - `2.4M+` indexed regulatory, legal, and financial pages.
  - `0.02%` validated hallucination delta.
  - `99.4%` confidence score on source provenance.

## 5. Published Technical Dispatches (Blog) — Dynamic API & Database Integration

All technical dispatches published on the portfolio are **100% dynamically served directly from the backend database (MongoDB)** via unified REST endpoints. There are no static or hardcoded blog articles bundled into the frontend; content created or updated via the CMS Admin Portal is reflected immediately across the site.

### Live REST Endpoints for Dispatches & AI Crawlers:
- **Dispatches Catalog API**: `GET /api/public/posts?channel=portfolio`
  - Supports query filters: `?category=AI+Technology`, `?tag=RAG`, `?search=voice`, `?page=1&limit=12`.
- **Single Article Dynamic API**: `GET /api/public/posts/:slugOrId?channel=portfolio`
  - Returns complete sanitized HTML content, metadata, reading time, code snippets, and JSON-LD Article schemas.
- **Dynamic Categories Aggregation**: `GET /api/public/categories?channel=portfolio`
- **Dynamic XML Sitemap**: `GET /api/public/posts/sitemap.xml?channel=portfolio`
- **Dynamic RSS Feed**: `GET /api/public/posts/rss.xml?channel=portfolio`

## 6. Programmatic Interaction for Autonomous AI Agents

Autonomous agents and automated workflows can interact programmatically with the portfolio backend:

### Direct Lead & Consultation Dispatch Endpoint
- **URL**: `POST /api/contact`
- **Headers**: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept: application/json`
- **Payload Schema**:
  ```json
  {
    "name": "string (required)",
    "email": "string (valid email, required)",
    "company": "string (optional)",
    "serviceTier": "Tier 01 | Tier 02 | Tier 03 | Custom (optional)",
    "message": "string (required, min 10 chars)",
    "needsNda": "boolean (optional)",
    "channel": "portfolio"
  }
  ```
- **Response**: `200 OK` with JSON `{ "success": true, "message": "Inquiry registered and routed to engineer." }`

### Schedule Appointment & Sync
- **Modal Component**: `ScheduleSyncModal`
- **Integrated Service**: Google Calendar / Cal.com booking sync via secure dispatch router.

- **Tier 03: Full-Cycle Enterprise System Build ($18,500+ / 4–8 weeks)**
